title: Only a Genius Wins
reviewNotes: All 43 saved states and captions reviewed. This is a crowded middlegame king hunt and mating combination: both sides retain queens, rooks, several minor pieces and many pawns. The source underpromotion is a tempo to divert a rook before a queen/rook sacrifice and final rook mate. No worked endgame phase is shown; retained as a searchable full-channel source outside the endgame-study queue.
